summary: Profusa, Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a First Amendment to an Asset Purchase Agreement with Bio Insights LLC. Profusa is acquiring substantially all know-how assets of Seller's PanOmics Assay for $30 million aggregate purchase price, to be satisfied via issuance of Series A Convertible Preferred Stock convertible into Profusa common stock. The Amendment deletes Section 4.6 (Management Shares) which had provided for 12% of fully diluted shares issued to its CEO and CFO. No advisors or board recommendation noted. The deal appears structured as an all-stock acquisition of assets. Watch regulatory timeline and conversion mechanics for risk-arb angle.
